subject: Reschedule request + CIO attendance — Redwood demo (Novapower)
messages:
From: Jen Owens <jen.owens@novapower.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21 09:14 PDT
Subject: Reschedule: Redwood demo — include CIO (Novapower)

Hi Rachel / Laura,

Quick ask — our CIO, Marcus Hale, just confirmed availability next week but only on Wednesday or Thursday morning PT. We currently have the demo booked for Tuesday at 10am PT. Can we move the session to one of these windows so Marcus can attend? Ideally we want the final 20 minutes to be a short executive summary with the CIO.

Is one of these workable for your execs? If Marcus joins, he generally prefers high-level outcomes and cost/latency numbers rather than deep infra slides. Also, can you confirm who from Redwood will lead the CIO portion — would be helpful to know if a VP/eng leader will be present or if we should expect an SE.

Attaching our attendee list for reference.

Thanks,
Jen Owens
Head of Cloud Platform
Novapower
(attachment: novapower-attendees.xlsx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Owens <jen.owens@novapower.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21 10:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Reschedule: Redwood demo — include CIO (Novapower)

Hi Jen — thanks for the heads up and congrats on getting Marcus on the calendar. We can definitely accommodate a reschedule. Proposed options: 

- Wednesday, Aug 25 — 11:00am–11:45am PT (preferred from our side)
- Thursday, Aug 26 — 9:00am–9:45am PT

If Marcus prefers a purely executive brief, we can carve out the last 20 minutes for the CIO summary (cost, latency, reliability, deployment options). Otherwise we can keep the standard 45-minute format with a 10-minute exec recap.

I will loop Ben in to confirm exec coverage but plan is to have a senior leader take the CIO portion and an engineer for the technical walkthrough. Attached: updated agenda (agenda-v2.docx) and a short 3‑page demo deck (deck-Redwood-Demo-3pp.pdf).

Would you and Marcus be open to a 15-minute pre-brief immediately before the demo so we can run through the one-slide executive summary?

Best,
Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai
(attachments: agenda-v2.docx, deck-Redwood-Demo-3pp.pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-21 11:20 PDT
Subject: Re: Reschedule: Redwood demo — include CIO (Novapower)

Rachel — I can take the CIO-facing summary on Wed 11:00am PT. If anything conflicts on my calendar I can hand off to Aditya as backup (Aditya — please stand by).

Suggested quick exec bullets for the slide:
- 1: What Redwood solves in one sentence (prod inference economics + reliability)
- 2: Measured latency and cost delta vs. baseline (we'll call out a conservative estimate)
- 3: Deployment options + data controls (Hosted / Dedicated / Private brief)
- 4: Next steps / procurement path (reserved capacity + pilot timeline)

I’ll be prepared to lead the 20-minute executive portion; Aditya can cover detailed quant benchmarks if Marcus asks.

Ben Carter
VP, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Jen Owens <jen.owens@novapower.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-22 08:37 PDT
Subject: Re: Reschedule: Redwood demo — include CIO (Novapower)

Thanks — Wed Aug 25 11:00am PT works for Marcus. We’d appreciate the 15-minute pre-brief at 10:30am PT so you can run the one-slide summary by Ben and Rachel. Marcus will join the demo proper at 11:00am.

Can you confirm the meeting invite will list Ben as the executive presenter and include the one-slide summary in the calendar materials? Also, please add links to any compliance artifacts we might request afterwards (SOC2/retention), that will help speed procurement.

See attached attendee list again (we added a security contact). Looking forward — Marcus is keen to understand deployment controls and the SLA route.

Best,
Jen Owens
Head of Cloud Platform
Novapower
(attachment: novapower-attendees.xlsx)

From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
To: Jen Owens <jen.owens@novapower.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>; Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>; Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-24 11:03 PDT
Subject: Re: Reschedule: Redwood demo — include CIO (Novapower)

Perfect — I’ve updated the calendar: Wed Aug 25, 10:30–10:45am PT (pre-brief) and 11:00–11:45am PT (demo). Ben will be listed as the executive presenter; Aditya as backup. I uploaded the one-slide executive summary to the event and attached the two slides we plan to use for the CIO portion.

Links added to the invite: SOC2 summary (public page), compliance whitepaper, and our procurement next-steps doc. HubSpot deal NV-2027-0412 updated with the new meeting times and notes.

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Jen — see you Wednesday.

Rachel Kim
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
Calendar link: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novapower_redwood_demo
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/1234567
